purpose: Additive expansion from the live 626-region world across the Central Asian Silk Road corridor into China and Mongolia.
principles: Modern borders are geometry sources, not historical political borders.
Build a connected east-west corridor so trade, disease and technology diffuse through geography rather than teleporting.
Use finer source geometry for China and Pakistan, then merge into durable gameplay regions.
Keep mountain corridors, oasis belts, major river basins and productive plains more detailed than steppe or desert interiors.
Do not reduce existing western map detail merely to offset new regions.
